item.title: Fort Worth ISD rejects motion on prayer in schools
item.description: School board members in the Fort Worth Independent School District voted Tuesday to reject a new policy that would add time for prayer in public schools.The vote complied with a state law passed last year requiring every Texas school board to vote on the issue.Senate Bill 11 was passed during last year’s legislative session.It requires every Texas school board to vote by March 1 on whether to adopt a policy creating designated time for prayer or reading religious texts during school.The Fort Wor

item.title: DART is lowering prices for some regional riders
item.description: Dallas Area Rapid Transit announced a price drop for some of its fares, along with a price increase for others.What’s changing?The changes affect the Regional Day Pass and the 31-Day Regional Day Pass.Beginning on March 1, the price of a Regional Day Pass will drop from $12 to $9, which is a 25% decrease. item.title: TCU football unveils special helmet for upcoming Ireland game
item.description: TCU football will play North Carolina in Ireland this fall, and they'll be wearing a special helmet for the occasion.Frogs across the pond"Clover Frog" will adorn TCU's helmet for the Aer Lingus College Football Classic in Dublin, Ireland. The helmet features the school's classic horned frog mascot clutching a clover in its mouth.The matchup, which will take place on Aug. 22, 2026, will be TCU's first time playing in Ireland.
